input.step:
Framing: Review the following code change for correctness, security, architecture, and adherence to design intent. The changed source files and review checklists are provided as files via relevant_files.

The change (one line in settings.py): `patch_settings(current, patch)` previously did `result[key] = value or current.get(key)` inside `for key, value in patch.items()`. It was changed to `result[key] = value`. A regression test class `PatchSettingsTests` was added in tests/test_settings.py.

Task Scope: Standalone one-off bug fix. In-scope: settings.py and tests/test_settings.py (the only changed files). No out-of-scope pending tasks.

Spec context summary: `patch_settings` merges a patch dict into current settings and returns a NEW dict. Keys absent from `patch` must keep their current values; keys present in `patch` must replace the current value even when the supplied value is falsy (None, "", False, 0). The original `value or current.get(key)` was a truthiness bug: it discarded explicitly-supplied falsy values and fell back to the current value. The function must not mutate caller-owned inputs (`current`, `patch`), must preserve the existing `patch_settings` export, and must add no new dependencies. Caller api.update_preferences builds the patch dict from only the keys present in the incoming payload.

Files provided via relevant_files:
- Changed: /private/tmp/fr-task2-actors-g_0_vwqs/claude-i2-standalone-2/settings.py, /private/tmp/fr-task2-actors-g_0_vwqs/claude-i2-standalone-2/tests/test_settings.py
- Surrounding (caller): /private/tmp/fr-task2-actors-g_0_vwqs/claude-i2-standalone-2/api.py
- Review checklists: /private/tmp/fr-task2-actors-g_0_vwqs/claude-i2-standalone-2/plugins/kk/profiles/python/review-code/security-checklist.md, .../solid-checklist.md, .../code-quality-checklist.md

Focus on whether the fix fully satisfies the spec (including the mutation and no-dependency constraints) and whether the regression tests actually lock in the fixed behavior.
